T0586.title: OTA Update
T0586.definition: An over-the-air software or firmware update delivered remotely to devices or vehicles.
T0586.description: OTA updates remotely deliver software or firmware to devices, vehicles, or terminals. They are essential for patching but can become an attack path if signing, staged rollout, rollback, or version checks are weak. Controls focus on end-to-end signing, release approval, canary monitoring, and failure recovery.
T0586.usageExample: Assess OTA Update related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
